other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a resident of the Union territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
Beneficiary must be engaged in any building and other construction work
Beneficiary must be registered under the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and have an active membership
Women employees must have been registered beneficiaries for a period of one year to receive the benefit
Male employees must have been registered beneficiaries for a period of one year and their wives must be 19 years or older and not registered beneficiaries
benefits_summary: Female employees receive a maternity benefit of ₹20,000, while male employees receive a maternity benefit of ₹10,000.
